confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Leh's tourist pricing. No live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine are not directly known: they are set at roughly 2x the beer anchor, a weak basis, and alcohol is scarcer and pricier in Ladakh. FX: the 0.6947 figure came from a third-party aggregator that states it reflects RBA rates for 16 October 2026. I did not open rba.gov.au and could not confirm the value there, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to South Asian high-altitude hill-station tourist towns such as Manali, Shimla and Srinagar, adjusted upward for Leh's remote location, short high-season demand and July accommodation premium.
